title: http-apis 1.0
description: What OpenCore MES's HTTP APIs promise in /v1 and how that may change: the AI design API (/ai/v1) operation by operation, the web services' envelope (/svc/v1), the headers every answer carries, and the operations deprecated, with their notice. The specification is README.md beside this file; surface.mjs compares a live OpenAPI document with this; kit.mjs checks a running instance.

x-policy.minor: adds: an operation, an optional request field, a field in an answer. Recorded here and in CHANGELOG.md first.
x-policy.breaking: removes or changes what is promised (an operation, its scope, a path parameter, a request field read, the error envelope, a status's meaning). Never in /v1: it goes to /v2, which runs beside /v1 at least until /v1's sunset.
x-policy.notice: what /v1 will lose is marked deprecated here first (since, sunset at least minNoticeDays later, successor); every answer to it then carries Deprecation, Sunset and Link headers, and its use is logged.

x-headers.API-Version: every answer of /ai/v1 and /svc/v1: the version of this contract the core provides (1.0)
x-headers.Deprecation: RFC 9745: on an answer to a deprecated operation or web service, when it was deprecated (@seconds)
x-headers.Sunset: RFC 8594: on the same, the date after which it may change or go
x-headers.Link: rel="successor-version": where to go instead; rel="deprecation": what changes

/svc/v1.openapi: /svc/v1/openapi.json (the web services this token's person may call: the plant's designs)
/svc/v1.request: POST /svc/v1/{service} with Authorization: Bearer <token> (scope service:call), Content-Type: application/json, optional Idempotency-Key (8 to 100 characters: the first answer is given again)

answers.401: no or bad token: { error, code: token.missing }
answers.403: missing scope or not among its callers: { error, code }
answers.409: the first request with this Idempotency-Key still runs: { error, code: idempotency.running }, Retry-After
answers.413: the body is too large: { error }
answers.422: refused by the service, a rule or a policy: { error, fields?, code? }
answers.502: a system it depends on could not be reached: { error }

/svc/v1.error: { error: words a person reads, code?: a stable identifier, fields?: { input: words } }
/svc/v1.services: each web service's input and answer are the plant's promise to its callers, governed by its change requests: a change that would break callers who called in the last 30 days needs the notice first (the service deprecated with a sunset, its callers told on every call) or a new name
